Visit note | 2025-10-12 04:00 PM | Dr. Sharmin Akter, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Samira Sheikh, 33, female. Mrs. Sheikh returns for review reporting extra hair growth on her face, new acne, and ongoing weight gain. She is a journalist and first noticed these changes after a friend in Mymensingh suggested testing. She has Essential hypertension. She denies severe pelvic pain or headaches. On examination: BMI 29.4, BP 137/92 mmHg, pulse 90 bpm, weight 61 kg. Cardiovascular and respiratory examinations are unremarkable. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up in 3 months.

Visit note | 2025-10-12 04:30 PM | Dr. Kamrul Hasan, Pulmonology | Patient: Iffat Haque, 36, female. Ms. Haque presents for her first visit complaining of a mild wheeze, no high fever, and a persistent cough for one to two weeks following a cold. She works as a bus driver and her symptoms began after a family wedding in Khulna. She has no known comorbidities. She denies chest pain or night sweats. On examination: temperature 99.8°F, BP 132/77 mmHg, pulse 78 bpm, SpO2 95%, weight 91 kg. Chest auscultation reveals scattered wheezes without dullness. Assessment: Acute bronchitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to drink warm fluids, use steam inhalation twice daily, and avoid smoke. Follow-up in 2 weeks if the cough continues.
